CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_link_company_account(existing_company_id uuid, user_email text, user_password text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_user_id uuid;
  company_name_from_table text;
  encrypted_password text;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Get Company Name
  SELECT company_name INTO company_name_from_table
  FROM public.companies
  WHERE id = existing_company_id;

  IF company_name_from_table IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No company found with ID: %', existing_company_id;
  END IF;

  -- 2. Prepare Data
  new_user_id := gen_random_uuid();
  encrypted_password := crypt(user_password, gen_salt('bf'));

  -- 3. Create User in auth.users (With Metadata for Routing)
  INSERT INTO auth.users (
    id,
    email,
    encrypted_password,
    aud,
    role,
    email_confirmed_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    raw_user_meta_data  -- <--- ADDED FOR ROUTING
  )
  VALUES (
    new_user_id,
    user_email,
    encrypted_password,
    'authenticated',
    'authenticated',
    now(),
    now(),
    now(),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'full_name', company_name_from_table,
      'role', 'company',       -- <--- CRITICAL: Identifies user type
      'signup_type', 'company' -- <--- Legacy support
    )
  );

  -- 4. [CRITICAL] Create Identity (Required for Login)
  INSERT INTO auth.identities (
    id, user_id, identity_data, provider, last_sign_in_at, created_at, updated_at, email
  )
  VALUES (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    new_user_id,
    jsonb_build_object('sub', new_user_id, 'email', user_email),
    'email',
    NULL,
    now(),
    now(),
    user_email
  );

  -- 5. Create Profile linkage
  INSERT INTO public.company_user_profiles (id, company_id, email, full_name, role)
  VALUES (
    new_user_id, 
    existing_company_id, 
    user_email, 
    company_name_from_table, 
    'company_admin'
  );

  RETURN new_user_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_create_company_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If the company is created with an owner (auth_user_id), create their profile
  IF NEW.auth_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.company_user_profiles (id, company_id, full_name, email, role)
    VALUES (
      NEW.auth_user_id,
      NEW.id,
      NEW.company_name,        -- Use Company Name as default Full Name
      NEW.contact_email,       -- Use Contact Email
      'company_admin'          -- Default role
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; -- Skip if already exists
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_daily_hours()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO employee_summary (employee_id, log_date, total_hours)
  SELECT
    employee_id,
    log_date,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (logout_time - login_time)) / 3600.0) AS total_hours
  FROM employee_logs
  WHERE logout_time IS NOT NULL
    AND log_date = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY employee_id, log_date;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_docs_reminder(p_client_id uuid, p_bureaus text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  -- If no specific bureaus provided, delete the reminder entirely
  if p_bureaus is null or array_length(p_bureaus, 1) is null then
    delete from public.docs_reminders where client_id = p_client_id;
    return;
  end if;

  -- Remove only the provided bureaus
  update public.docs_reminders r
     set bureaus = array(
       select e from unnest(coalesce(r.bureaus, '{}'::text[])) e
       except
       select e2 from unnest(p_bureaus) e2
     )
   where r.client_id = p_client_id;

  -- If nothing left, delete the row
  delete from public.docs_reminders
   where client_id = p_client_id
     and (bureaus is null or coalesce(array_length(bureaus, 1), 0) = 0);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.count_business_days(start_date date, end_date date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    business_days INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- If start is after end, return 0 to avoid negative numbers
    IF start_date > end_date THEN
        RETURN 0;
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO business_days
    FROM generate_series(start_date, end_date, '1 day'::interval) AS day
    WHERE 
        -- 1. Exclude Weekends (ISO Day of Week: 6=Sat, 7=Sun)
        EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM day) < 6 
        
        -- 2. Exclude Holidays found in your new table
        AND day::date NOT IN (SELECT date FROM public.company_holidays);

    RETURN business_days;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_company_agents(target_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.role
  FROM public.company_user_profiles p
  WHERE p.company_id = target_company_id
  -- Optional: Filter to only show 'agent' or 'company_admin' roles if desired
  AND p.role IN ('agent', 'company_admin', 'owner', 'admin')
  ORDER BY p.full_name;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_role text := coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'client');
  v_signup_type text := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'signup_type';
BEGIN
  -- 🛑 SEPARATION GUARD:
  -- If the user is one of these types, they have their own tables.
  -- Do NOT create a generic 'profiles' row for them.
  IF v_role IN ('individual', 'client', 'company', 'company_admin', 'agent', 'affiliate') 
     OR v_signup_type IN ('individual', 'company', 'affiliate') THEN
     RETURN NEW; 
  END IF;

  -- ✅ Only proceed if it is an Admin, Owner, or Staff role
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, role)
  VALUES (new.id, new.email, v_role)
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
    SET email = EXCLUDED.email,
        role  = EXCLUDED.role;
        
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_call_metrics(uid uuid, ldate date, total_calls integer, total_docs integer, total_disputes integer, total_confirmed integer, total_unable_to_dispute integer, total_disconnected integer, total_count integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO call_metrics (
    employee_id, log_date,
    total_calls, total_docs, total_disputes,
    total_confirmed, total_unable_to_dispute, total_disconnected, total_count
  )
  VALUES (
    uid, ldate,
    total_calls, total_docs, total_disputes,
    total_confirmed, total_unable_to_dispute, total_disconnected, total_count
  )
  ON CONFLICT (employee_id, log_date)
  DO UPDATE SET
    total_calls = call_metrics.total_calls + EXCLUDED.total_calls,
    total_docs = call_metrics.total_docs + EXCLUDED.total_docs,
    total_disputes = call_metrics.total_disputes + EXCLUDED.total_disputes,
    total_confirmed = call_metrics.total_confirmed + EXCLUDED.total_confirmed,
    total_unable_to_dispute = call_metrics.total_unable_to_dispute + EXCLUDED.total_unable_to_dispute,
    total_disconnected = call_metrics.total_disconnected + EXCLUDED.total_disconnected,
    total_count = call_metrics.total_count + EXCLUDED.total_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND (
      role = 'admin' OR
      role = 'owner' OR
      role = 'subadmin' OR
      role = 'callers' OR
      role = 'counters'
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_disputed_result(t text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(upper(trim(t)) in (
    'DISPUTED','PARTLY DISPUTED','STILL UNDER DISPUTE','ACCOUNTS DISPUTED'
  ), false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_privileged()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
      from public.profiles p
     where p.id = auth.uid()
       and p.role in ('owner','admin','subadmin')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_inquiry_removals(records jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  rec record;
begin
  for rec in
    select 
      (r->>'client_id')::uuid as client_id,
      (r->>'admin_id')::uuid as admin_id,
      (r->>'bureau')::text as bureau,
      (r->>'log_date')::date as log_date,
      (r->>'removed_count')::int as removed_count
    from jsonb_array_elements(records) as r
  loop
    insert into inquiry_removals (client_id, admin_id, bureau, log_date, removed_count)
    values (rec.client_id, rec.admin_id, rec.bureau, rec.log_date, rec.removed_count)
    on conflict (client_id, admin_id, bureau, log_date)
    do update set removed_count = inquiry_removals.removed_count + EXCLUDED.removed_count;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_docs_to_calls(p_doc_task_id uuid, p_client_id uuid, p_target_date date, p_admin_id uuid, p_log_note text, p_exp_update text, p_tu_update text, p_eq_update text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- 1. Update Client Bureau Statuses (Only if a string is provided)
    UPDATE clients SET 
        exp_status = COALESCE(p_exp_update, exp_status),
        tu_status = COALESCE(p_tu_update, tu_status),
        eq_status = COALESCE(p_eq_update, eq_status)
    WHERE id = p_client_id;

    -- 2. Mark Doc Task as COMPLETED
    UPDATE document_routing SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = p_doc_task_id;

    -- 3. Create new Call Routing Task
    INSERT INTO call_routing (client_id, scheduled_date, status, assigned_admin_id)
    VALUES (p_client_id, p_target_date, 'PENDING', NULL);

    -- 4. Insert Document Log
    INSERT INTO document_logs (client_id, admin_id, note, submitted_at)
    VALUES (p_client_id, p_admin_id, p_log_note, now());

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_docs_to_calls(p_doc_task_id uuid, p_client_id uuid, p_target_date date, p_admin_id uuid, p_call_admin_id uuid, p_log_note text, p_exp_update text, p_tu_update text, p_eq_update text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- 1. Update Client Bureau Statuses
    UPDATE clients SET 
        exp_status = COALESCE(p_exp_update, exp_status),
        tu_status = COALESCE(p_tu_update, tu_status),
        eq_status = COALESCE(p_eq_update, eq_status)
    WHERE id = p_client_id;

    -- 2. Mark Doc Task as COMPLETED
    UPDATE document_routing SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = p_doc_task_id;

    -- 3. Create new Call Routing Task assigned to the specific Caller!
    INSERT INTO call_routing (client_id, scheduled_date, status, assigned_admin_id)
    VALUES (p_client_id, p_target_date, 'PENDING', p_call_admin_id);

    -- 4. Insert Document Log
    INSERT INTO document_logs (client_id, admin_id, note, submitted_at)
    VALUES (p_client_id, p_admin_id, p_log_note, now());
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_uploaded_on_first_doc()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE clients
     SET is_uploaded = TRUE,
         uploaded_timestamp = COALESCE(uploaded_timestamp, now())
   WHERE id = NEW.client_id
     AND COALESCE(is_uploaded, FALSE) = FALSE;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_docs_reminder(p_client_id uuid, p_admin_id uuid, p_note text, p_bureaus text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
insert into public.docs_reminders (client_id, admin_id, note, bureaus, first_seen, last_seen)
values (
  p_client_id,
  p_admin_id,
  p_note,
  case
    when p_bureaus is null or array_length(p_bureaus,1) = 0 then null
    else (select array_agg(distinct b) from unnest(p_bureaus) b)
  end,
  now(),
  now()
)
on conflict (client_id) do update
set
  admin_id = coalesce(excluded.admin_id, public.docs_reminders.admin_id),
  note     = coalesce(excluded.note, public.docs_reminders.note),
  bureaus  = (
    select case when count(*)=0 then null
                else array_agg(distinct b)
           end
    from unnest(
      coalesce(public.docs_reminders.bureaus, '{}'::text[])
      || coalesce(excluded.bureaus, '{}'::text[])
    ) b
  ),
  last_seen = now();
$function$
